_doc: Public adult reference ranges (indicative screening intervals) for the canonical items in lab_synonyms.json.
low/high: numeric bounds in `unit` (null = one-sided). Bounds are inclusive unless low_exclusive/high_exclusive is true
(e.g. fasting glucose high=100 with high_exclusive: 100 itself is already abnormal).
sex_specific: {M: [lo, hi], F: [lo, hi]} overrides low/high when sex is known. qualitative_normal: expected qualitative result.
Reference ranges printed on the report take precedence. See reference_ranges.README.md.
